verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests server-side data loading through SvelteKit: it is described as similar to Next.js, and a community member says it is now clear what is loaded on the server versus the client. Nothing in the pack documents async server-rendered components or the mechanism for passing fetched data down to interactive client components. Missing for 10: documentation of async server-rendered components, a documented server-to-client data-passing mechanism (e.g., load functions/props), code examples, hands-on corroboration.
